name: Heltermaa-Ristna-Sarve haru II lõik Kärdla-Ristna
description_md:
The route is named Heltermaa-Ristna-Sarve haru II lõik Kärdla-Ristna and is a waymarked hiking route in EE. It is part of a national waymarked hiking network and is signposted as HRS.

The distance is 106.6 km with 848 m of ascent and 834 m of descent. Walking time takes about 29 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent. The route passes Hiiumaa within 100 m.
